channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: A Sister's Journey
item.description: Explore a charmingly beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art world and help Violet on her journey searching for her sister. Uncover its mysteries, face its threatening foes, and run 'n gun your way through this challenging action-metroidvania - which will put your true platforming skills to the test.

item.title: AKIBA LOST
item.description: Thirteen years ago, six girls vanished in Akihabara in the unsolved case “The Akiba Vanishing”. Daiki Shinjo announces a live-action game based on the incident, gathering six women who embody Akihabara’s subculture. But their story begins to seep into reality. Can AKIBA LOST be finished?

item.title: Bridge Constructor Portal
item.description: Enter the Aperture Science Enrichment Center and experience Bridge Constructor Portal – the unique merging of the classic Portal™ and Bridge Constructor™ games.

item.title: Howling Woods
item.description: A cozy Halloween town builder. Lay out paths and plots in a clearing in the woods and the town takes care of the rest: crooked houses go up, curio shops open, and goblins, ghosts and witches move in. The spookier your town gets, the grander it grows. Nothing costs a thing. Every day is Halloween!

item.title: I Am Your Beast - Quitting Time DLC
item.description: Remember: you're one of the good guys. Fight a shadow war in Southeast Asia in this story prequel DLC to indie hit I Am Your Beast.

item.title: UBERMOSH
item.description: UBERMOSH is an arcade game about cutting bullets with a sword, in a gun-filled cyberpunk mosh pit.

item.title: Cepheus Protocol
item.description: Cepheus Protocol is an Open World RTS Military Survival Game. Play as the CERC hunting Patient 0, maintain Quarantine camps, fight dangerous mutations & Rogue Civilian Combatants . There’s nobody else coming, it’s up to you now.

item.title: AI Olympius
item.description: Join the rebels in a third-person shooter with RPG elements and base-building mode. Fight against various combat drone models under the control of the supreme AI.

item.title: AIR
item.description: Summer stretches on endlessly. Beneath the vast blue sky. Beneath the air in which she awaits— AIR, the second game released by visual novel studio Key, is now available on Steam! Now featuring the side story novel, "First Sky Chapter" and full voice support!

item.title: Athanasia
item.description: Fight the past in Athanasia, an immersive horror FPS set in an abandoned research facility overrun with prehistoric predators. Outwit nature, delve deep and uncover the facility's mysteries.

item.title: Bloodshed
item.description: Bloodshed is a Roguelite Survivors FPS; an exhilarating fusion of Roguelite elements merged with retro-styled visuals and first-person “Survivors-like” frenetic combat action!

item.title: Coin Harvest
item.description: Robotic arms sweep a steady pour of coins off your plateau. Unlock islands, conquer six realms and ascend for crystals in an idle game that sits on your desktop while you work or play.

item.title: Little Busters! English Edition
item.description: Capturing the hearts of countless fans since 2007, Little Busters! is an emotional visual novel from Key, the minds behind Angel Beats! and CLANNAD. This special English release supports touch controls and dynamic switching between English and Japanese text, and is in HD for the first time on PC.

item.title: To the Moon
item.description: A story-driven experience about two doctors traversing backwards through a dying man's memories to artificially fulfill his last wish.

item.title: Warding Witches
item.description: Warding Witches offers a classic, unapologetic bullet hell shoot ‘em up challenge while also putting defense into players’ hands. Experience an adrenaline-filled flow alternating between attacking, defending and dodging, amplified by an intuitive scoring system that weaves into gameplay seamlessly.

item.title: Big Dig
item.description: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway across the Animal Republic!

item.title: Empires of the Undergrowth - Exploding Ants
item.description: Field new weapons on the battlefield for ants and termites alike with two explosive new species in your Empires of the Undergrowth.

item.title: Fallout 76: Mojave Bundle
item.description: Grab your NCR Power Armor and patrol the desert of Burning Springs with the Mojave Bundle. Fallout 76 base game required, sold separately.

item.title: Lawn Mowing Simulator
item.description: Experience the beauty and detail of mowing the Great British countryside in Lawn Mowing Simulator, the only simulator that allows you to ride an authentic and expansive roster of real-world licensed lawn mowers from prestigious manufacturers; Toro, SCAG and STIGA as you manage your business.

item.title: Pumpkin Jack
item.description: Pumpkin Jack is a Spooky Scary 3D platformer in which you embody Jack, the Mythical Pumpkin Lord! Dive into an Epic Adventure through otherworldly landscapes and help the Evil annihilate the Good!

item.title: Symphonia
item.description: Awaken an expansive musical realm in this non-violent and poetic platformer. In Symphonia, you'll use the power of your violin coupled with your platforming skills to gather an orchestra to bring the musical machinery of the world back to life.

item.title: Tropico 7
item.description: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

item.title: Squad Weapon Skins - Recon Team Pack
item.description: This pack contains 5 woodland weapon skins for the USMC faction.

item.title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Gear.Club Signature Pack
item.description: Get the Gear.Club Signature Pack and enjoy two exclusive liveries: the Honda S2000 GCU3 Edition and the BMW Z4 GCU Edition. Taking inspiration from Japanese culture, they will transform your cars into works of art!
